text:
Maya (CS): proposing a tiny A/B test for onboarding priming strategies to see which reduces cold-starts faster. A = small targeted seed set (20 prompts). B = broader random prefill (50 pings). Goal: pick winner by 24h cache-hit delta and 72h error reduction. Thoughts?

Iris (Eng): interesting. For A, normalize prompts (remove ids) so cache keys align. For B, keep lower concurrency to avoid noise. Suggest batch_size=4 for A, batch_size=8 for B.

Derek (SRE): ops must know how to abort. If 5xx > 3% for 2m OR p90 rises > 30% vs baseline -> stop experiment, revert to vanilla rollout, and shift 30% traffic to fallback. Add an alert channel and playbook link.

Sam (PM): add renewal-signal capture per cohort: baseline p90, cache-hit% at 24h, error-budget burn, and CS sentiment at 72h (green/amber/red). Those feed renewal risk model.

Maya (CS): customer-facing copy for kickoff email (short): "We'll run a short priming test (A/B) during kickoff to identify the fastest warmup approach. We'll share a 24h snapshot and a 72h check-in. If we see issues we'll stop the test and failover."

Iris (Eng): small safe scripts for customers (pick one):
A) targeted seed (recommended): `seq 1 20 | xargs -n1 -P4 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-3b\",\"input\":\"<seed>\",\"max_tokens\":16}'`
B) broad prefill: `for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-3b\",\"input\":\"ping-$i\",\"max_tokens\":8}' & sleep 0.15; done; wait`

Derek (SRE): metric queries to include in the snapshot:
- success qps: `rate(http_requests_total{service=\"redwood\",status!~\"5..\"}[5m])`
- cache hit rate: `sum(increase(cache_hits_total[1h]))/sum(increase(cache_lookups_total[1h]))`
- p90 latency: `histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`

Maya (CS): short start-config recommendations for customers: prefill_A=20 seed prompts, prefill_B=50 random pings, batch_A=4, batch_B=8, concurrency=1-3, warm_pool_request=optional for Dedicated.

Sam (PM): cost note: estimate token cost for both arms in the kickoff email and explain Dedicated warm pools for steady-state. Also capture customer preference if they want us to run the warmup or self-serve.

Maya (CS): feedback capture: after 72h CS should record winner (A/B/No-diff), delta in cache-hit% at 24h, and one-line customer sentiment. I'll add a short template to enablement.

cs-bot: reminder set  follow-up checklist to @Maya (CS) scheduled in 72 hours. :white_check_mark:

Maya (CS): thanks team. I'll add this A/B priming plan to the enablement repo and the kickoff template. Tag me for edits.
